test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On the 74th republic day of India, President of Egypt, ____________ was the Chief Guest at the Republic Day parade.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdel Fattah El-Sisi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Abdel Fattah El-Sisi** was the **Chief Guest at the 74th Republic Day parade **of India.
 
• He is the **President of Egypt**, a position he has held since 2014.
 
• His presence marked a significant moment in the diplomatic relations between India and Egypt.
 
• T
